With the compact and efficient Cuisinart CWC-800 8 Bottle Private Reserve Wine Cellar you'll always have the right wine on hand. This cooler has the capacity to hold up to eight bottles of your favorite wines and features a simple silhouette finished in stainless steel to provide a modern display for the bottles. The controlled interior temperature ensures that your wine collection maintains the best temperature to enhance its bouquet flavor and body. You control the ideal temperature between 39 and 68 degrees F with an electronic touchpad and blue LED display. Because of its unique thermoelectric cooling system this cooler runs quietly and has low-energy consumption.About CuisinartOne of the most recognized names in cookware and kitchen products Cuisinart first became popular when introduced to the public by culinary experts Julia Child and James Beard. In 1973 the Cuisinart food processor revolutionized the way we create fine food and healthy dishes and since that time Cuisinart has continued its path of innovation. Under management by the Conair Corporation since 1989 Cuisinart is a universally celebrated name in kitchens across the globe. With a full-service product line including bakeware blenders coffeemakers cookware countertop appliances kitchen tools and much much more Cuisinart products are preferred by chefs and loved by consumers for durability ease of use superior quality and style.
